description.en: Ibn Majah compiled the sixth and final book of the Kutub al-Sitta. His Sunan is distinguished by its focus on jurisprudential hadith. It contains 4,341 hadith, some found exclusively in this collection. He traveled from Qazvin to Iraq, Hijaz, Egypt and Syria collecting hadith.
